Maya (Docs): Heads-up — docs CI (linkcheck) failed on the latest publish after the anchor-prune run. Build: https://ci.internal.redwood/6054/result :frowning:
CI Bot: FAILED • docs/linkcheck • 6054321987 • 1 error :x:
Jon (Eng-Docs): which page? can you paste the failing fragment(s)?
Maya (Docs): the error is duplicate fragment anchors. e.g. two generated ids for the same heading after the prune step. snippet:
```
Warning: duplicate anchor found for /guides/quickstart.html#install
Generated anchors: guide-quickstart-install, guide_quickstart_install
```
Maya (Docs): looks like headings with em-dashes & smart quotes are normalized differently across the pipeline. the anchor-prune script removed explicit ids so fallback slugify produced collisions.
Eli (DevEx): ok. quick local repro: run `yarn docs:linkcheck` (it uses docusaurus/linkcheck). you can also run `npx docusaurus build` to see slugify output.
Sasha (Platform): FYI our builder image is on Docusaurus v2.1.0 — there was a slugify tweak in 2.2 that changes how punctuation is handled. might be mismatch between prune tool (node slugify@1.x) and builder.
Maya (Docs): proposed short-term fixes:
- add explicit id to the problematic heading: `## Install {#install}`
- update anchor-prune to preserve existing explicit ids
- add CI sanity: run `anchor-normalize` check in linkcheck job
Which one should we do in the hotfix PR?
Jon (Eng-Docs): I'll take the explicit-id route for the hotfix (fastest). will open PR to add explicit ids on the handful of colliding headings and a small CI tweak to run `anchor-normalize --check` as part of linkcheck.
Maya (Docs): thx. also need to ensure SDK snippet code blocks escape triple backticks — saw one example where a snippet containing ```python block broke mdx rendering. add fenced block like:
```md
```python
# example inside docs that shows backticks
print("use triple backticks inside md codeblock")
```
```
Jon (Eng-Docs): got it. opening PR now: https://git.internal.redwood/p/docs/anchors-fix/pull/224 :eyes: will add tests + update the anchor-prune config to skip keys when explicit id present.
CI Bot: Re-run queued: docs/linkcheck • 6054322100 • queued :arrows_clockwise:
Maya (Docs): perfect. once PR is merged, can someone re-run the full publish? want to confirm there are no other collisions.
Jon (Eng-Docs): will request a re-run after merge. :thumbsup:
Maya (Docs): thanks everyone — leaving a note in the PR about Docusaurus mismatch and follow-up to upgrade builder image next sprint. :sparkles:
